## Specifications

- **Rear axle housing type (Manual)**: M226 [t879] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Note that manual Xterras not equipped with Off-Road or Pro-4X trims typically have M226 axles. [t879]
- Be aware that the R180 is common on manual Xterras unless they are Off-Road or Pro-4X models. [t879]
